betterMoveDoes: Playing column c7 blocks Gray's immediate vertical win at c7r4 (the four c7r1·c7r2·c7r3·c7r4); the played move (column c6) lets Gray complete it on the very next move. Both branches still lose, but c7 forces Gray to grind ~20 more plies (terminal ply 42) instead of conceding on ply 22.
